findings.disposition: Read-only public config properties backed by private MappingProxyType in both ledger and reducer; checkpoints serialize explicit dict copies.

Snapshot checkpoint entries retain the exact admitted delta cursor. Restore applies complete prefix batches at each recorded cursor before rebuilding that historical snapshot, then restores the suffix.
TransactionSnapshot contains canonical full immutable configuration metadata and its hash, including anchor, row origin/width, terms, units, multiplier, coverage and bounds.
Pure reconciliation renamed known_at to input_known_at and has non-init published=False. Runtime port declares UnpublishedReconciliation with these fields; no compute time is invented.

Conditional distinct execution counts become None if any trade record has missing comparison price/condition or a non-whole-print aggregation unit. Explicit left/right and primary record counts remain separate from execution certainty.

Single-row transaction adapter exports no certified order. Tape view restores local order only within a fully declared common provider/dataset/publisher/channel/acquisition-session domain at the event-time tie; cross-domain or absent-domain ties remain unordered.

MBPInstrumentMapping binds dataset/schema to typed dated InstrumentDefinition. Adapter validates provider, raw instrument, exact lifetime coordinate, full FuturesTerms, actual publisher/sequence and acquisition scope. Channel remains absent; mapping evidence is retained with unchanged raw source bytes and event IDs.

Each delta retains ordered atomic batch version membership and member index, with a derived batch identity. Reducer validates complete contiguous membership before mutation; sliced/reordered pending resolution batches fail atomically.

Added width4/origin1 profile case spanning negative and positive prices and a correction; explicit RowGrid.lower_tick converts legacy row indices before parity against independent full raw replay and incremental profile coordinates.
Explicitly asserts frozen G20 observed unknown-sign mass versus no-row missing history, and separately no-row certified empty history.

confirmation.source_caller_search: All transaction adapter/delta/snapshot/reconciliation callers in src, references and tests inspected; no old production reconciliation known_at or primary print field callers remain. Frozen golden key remains preserved and its whole-print fixture is compared through record counts.
confirmation.complete_static_review: Reviewed new immutable config initialization/access/checkpoint paths, snapshot capture/replay cursor boundaries, atomic batch grouping/restore, matching shape/clock/count semantics, MBP definition and source scope checks, full changed tests, unaffected independent oracle and existing tape/bar/CVD/profile/TPO/dwell interfaces.

remaining: Root repair confirmation and one registered shared full-suite execution remain required.
No native condition, ownership, full-cohort availability or economic phase closure is claimed.
Pure reconciliation remains unpublished until an actual timed envelope exists; partial unsupported execution counts are unavailable.
